integrity: The argument is analytic. It checks the source hypotheses on a standard normal law, uses exact order-statistic reflection and translation invariance, and derives the missing additive constant directly from the quantile-density equation. No numerical experiment or inaccessible result is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample addresses the converse fixed-q characterizations for Shannon entropy and, at \(\alpha=2\), Tsallis entropy, Rényi entropy, the information generating function, and extropy. It does not claim the same failure for weighted extropy. The additive-constant diagnosis is proved on full support \(\mathbb R\) under positive-density differentiability assumptions; other supports can impose boundary anchors.
title: Wrong-center reflections defeat translation-invariant q-symmetry characterizations
